confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several consistent Madrid sources, though many are undated or secondhand (Numbeo-attributed figures were seen only via secondary sites). Dorm and 3-star hotel anchors come from 2026 guides that give ranges, and July is peak season for hostels. Cocktail is the least certain: sources range from about EUR 7 at an average bar to about EUR 15 in clubs, so EUR 11 is a midpoint. The private hostel room and 1-star hotel are bounded estimates built from dorm and hostal ranges, not directly observed prices. EUR is converted at roughly 1.12 USD, an approximation from a mid-October 2026 cross-rate in search results, not a July rate. FX: the RBA figure comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rate page, which I did not read directly. It is dated 2026-03-20 and is likely stale relative to the July 2026 window and the generation date.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used; Madrid-specific sources were available. Cocktail was set at about three times the beer anchor because direct sources conflicted. Wine glass was set from direct restaurant ranges and checked against beer (about 1.1 times beer).
